Of the unclaimed prize money on "Billion", about three-quarters is in wins under $5,000. The game is a game that pays many small prizes and few large ones. That is neither good nor bad, only how it was designed. Choose the kind of game that fits the win you want.

The second-biggest prize left on "Billion" is $1 million, with 41 of them remaining.

Everything above about "Billion" comes from the Ohio Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
762.headline: Where the prize money is

827.body:
"50th Anniversary" has one of three top prizes left and is in the last part of its run. Most of the tickets are already sold. As a game goes on, the same prizes are spread across fewer tickets. Right now, the top prizes are being claimed more slowly than the tickets are selling, which is a good sign.

The most common prize left on "50th Anniversary" right now is $100.

Today's free summary of "50th Anniversary" ends here. Every number behind it is on this page.
827.headline: How far along this game is

847.body:
Before you buy "Bingo 50X", know that its $500,000 top prize is gone. The game still pays many smaller prizes, but the biggest one left is $100,000. That is less than the ticket advertises, though still a sizable prize.

If you play "Bingo 50X" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
847.headline: The advertised top prize is gone

891.body:
The most common win left on "Cash Explosion 25X" is $5. The second biggest prize left is $10,000, and one of those are still unclaimed. The prize table is what defines a scratcher, and this page counts every level of it.

The numbers for "Cash Explosion 25X" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
